title: NELA-PS: A Dataset of Pink Slime News Articles for the Study of Local News Ecosystems
reasoning: The paper focuses on presenting a new dataset (NELA-PS) of news articles from deceptive 'pink slime' outlets. While it contains a section on Ethics and discusses the partisan/biased nature of the sources, it does not benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics as defined by the criteria.
